checks.what: the file is in order of participant, session, block and trial, with no duplicate trials
ACC is 0/1 and RT is positive on every row
block types: TrialList (sequence) and RandomTrialList (random) only
the codebook's Session label agrees with SessionNr (During/5Min/Post)
StimCondition is constant within participant and SessionNr
every row kept, in the authors' order
counterbalancing and task order are constant within participant

differences: In the deposit, trials 1-9 are absent from most blocks (block trial numbers start at 10 in 1806 of 2944 blocks); the deposit does not say why, and nothing was added.

excluded_by_authors marks wrong responses, response times under 100 ms and over 2000 ms, the exclusions the Methods of the 2024 companion paper (same lab, same task) describe; the practice block exclusion is already in the deposit. The authors' R script is not in the deposit, so the flag was not checked against it.

The readme says block 7 is the random block; in the deposit block 7 is random in all full-length sessions except 1 (block 6 is random there instead, with block 7 sequential), and block_type follows the deposit's block list column as given.

The abstract-level counts per group (45 conventional, 44 high-definition) are the deposit's; the paper text could not be read (publisher blocked), so only the participant count of 89 from the abstract and readme was checked.
1 participant has both sexes in the deposit across sessions; the rows are kept as given.
